brand: Council of AI — Global Regulation Atlas
title: The deep index — every dimension the estate carries, joined or declared apart
purpose: One artifact joining the sector×framework content, the industry pages, the Distribution Hive account spine, the Layer 0 trust floor, the measured board and the deadline register — and listing, as data, every cross-dimension binding that has no published artifact yet.
measurement_not_certification: This index carries descriptions and states exactly as their sources serve them. A binding declared absent is a fact about published artifacts, not a judgment about compliance. Nothing here is legal opinion.
content_sha256_rule: sha256 over canonicalJson(content) — sorted keys, no whitespace — where content is the seven layers plus anchors and layer_meta, WITHOUT generated_at and WITHOUT the hash itself. Same canonical rule as the card digest family; recomputable from the artifact itself.

sources.accounts: client/src/data/ecosystem.ts (committed bytes, org-level public fields only)
sources.layer0: client/src/pages/Layer0.tsx + client/src/data/layer0Nodes.ts (committed bytes, titles and registry fields)

deadlines.basis: Art 111(4), inserted by Digital Omnibus Reg (EU) 2026/1744 Art 1(39)(b)

bindings.note: No artifact maps a sectors-content industry path to GSPC axes or findings. The only sector-level binding published is public/interop/white-label-sector-crosswalk.json, covering 3 white-label sectors (insurance, bond, cobol) and none of the industry paths in this index.
Two industry vocabularies exist — the sector-page paths (including compound forms like finance-banking and legal-law-firms) and the industry-page slugs — with no published mapping between them.
The sector pages carry prose pointers to /crosswalk/east-west-v1.json, but no published artifact binds an individual sector×framework entry to specific crosswalk rows or concepts.

The account spine names framework tokens (eu-ai-act, dora, nis2, ...) and the sector content names the same frameworks, but no published artifact joins an account's framework list to sector framework coverage.
The frozen regulatory inventory points at hashed provision crosswalks; no published artifact binds any account's frameworks or jurisdictions to specific inventory provisions.
No published artifact joins an account's jurisdictions to the deadline register rows that bite them.
Deadline rows cite instruments and articles; the inventory pointer lists provisions. Nothing published joins the two.
No published artifact binds a GSPC axis to any framework token the sector content uses.
No published artifact binds a Layer 0 control level (L0-1/L0-2/L0-3) to any measured board axis.
Both layers name real public organisations, but no published artifact identifies Layer 0 registry nodes with account-spine entries (or declares them disjoint).

crosswalk.method: Row, regime and concept counts measured from the fetched crosswalk payload at build time, never typed.

regulatoryInventoryPointer.method: Frozen-inventory pointer fields read from the fetched payload at build time; the pointer's own scope note governs interpretation.

sectors_frameworks.extraction: JSON.parse of the exported array literal in client/src/data/sectors-content.ts (sliced from `export const sectorsdata: SectorsDataEntry[] = [ ... ];`); all entries parsed clean. industry_path and framework are derived per slug by longest-suffix match against the framework tokens the slugs themselves use (uk-ai-regulation, eu-ai-act, iso-42001, uk-ai, gdpr, hipaa, nis2, cra, dora); a slug matching none keeps framework null and is listed in unresolved_framework_slugs.

industries.extraction: JSON.parse of the exported array literal in client/src/data/industries-content.ts (`export const industriesdata: IndustriesDataEntry[] = [ ... ];`); slug and title only; all entries parsed clean.

accounts.extraction: String-aware top-level field scan of the ECOSYSTEM array literal in client/src/data/ecosystem.ts (unquoted TS keys; every value verbatim, nothing completed). Org-level public fields only: hq coordinates and the free-text source/currentVendor recon fields stay in the source file and out of this artifact. sector is omitted where the source omits it; posture/vendor unknown stays unknown.

layer0.extraction: Structured extraction of the array literals in client/src/pages/Layer0.tsx (L0_LEVELS control-level names, BENCH topics — titles only) plus the audited node registry the page renders from, client/src/data/layer0Nodes.ts (LAYER0_NODES: id, name, cls, status). Node coordinates and prose fields stay in the registry file.

board_axes.extraction: Fetched live from GET /api/gspc at build time; per-axis fields the board serves (axis, kind, status, accuracy, n, separation), absent where the board omits them.
board_axes.board_lid: 34 axes measured · 14 model comparisons: 0 separated · 7 TIE · 7 UNTESTED · 9 fact runs · TIE is TIE · not a certificate.

deadlines.extraction: Fetched live from GET /api/regulation at build time. Prose fields (what, penalty_exposure) are quoted by the register and deliberately not copied here — one `what` row carries a currency amount (a quoted revenue threshold), and this artifact quotes no amounts.
deadlines.days_until_rule: date minus build date 2026-11-08 (UTC), whole days; past dates negative

bindings.extraction: The DECLARED-GAP layer: every cross-dimension binding this index checked for and did not find published. Verified against the tree at authoring time; partial bindings are named in the notes rather than absorbed. A gap closed by a later artifact must be removed from this list in the same commit that publishes the artifact.

anchors.extraction: Counts and pointer fields measured from fetched payloads at build time.
